source_campaign: CBO | EXCEL | INT | 50+ BANNERS - нови банери (процес нови статични криейтиви, Стъпка 4)

banners.prompt:
Create a NEW, finished Facebook/Instagram feed advertising banner for a Bulgarian audience, from scratch.
IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The photo/background must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames).
LAYOUT SAFE ZONE (critical): the top 14% and the bottom 14% of the frame will be cut off afterwards. Put NOTHING important there - only continuation of the background. ALL text lines, faces, the book and the CTA button must be inside the middle 72% of the frame height. Keep about 6% side margins for text.
COMPOSITION NOTE: frame the shot wide enough that there is calm empty background above the headline and below the CTA button. The headline starts around 18-20% from the top; the CTA button sits around 80-86% and is fully visible with space under it.
EXACT VERTICAL LAYOUT (percent of the full frame height, measured from the top): 0-15% only background. 16-33% the headline (two lines). 34-79% the sofa scene. 81-87% the CTA button. 88-100% only background. Do not put any text or the button outside these zones.
FORMAT: PAIN - a real photo of the moment with the problem (IMAGE 3 is our winning PAIN banner style - use it only for typography and layout, not its scene).
The setting is ordinary Bulgarian everyday life (a modest Bulgarian office with old furniture, or an ordinary Bulgarian home). The people are Bulgarians around 52-62 years old, natural, likeable, real faces (not models). Any phone or computer screen shows no brand logos.
SCREEN ORIENTATION (critical): every laptop, monitor and phone screen faces the person who uses it. We never see a screen from the front while the person sits behind it. If the screen content must be visible, the camera is behind or beside the person (over-the-shoulder or side view), so we see the back of the monitor's user and the screen together; otherwise we see only the back of the laptop lid or monitor.
SCENE: an over-the-shoulder view from slightly behind the sofa, ordinary Bulgarian living room in the evening. A grandmother around 60 (seen from behind-side, face in three-quarter profile) sits on the sofa; her grandson around 10 sits next to her, both facing a coffee table. On the coffee table in front of them an open laptop faces THEM, and we see its screen over their shoulders: a blank spreadsheet with empty grid lines (no readable text). The boy holds his phone up towards his grandmother (screen facing her). She looks at the laptop with a slightly lost, uncertain look, hand at her chin. The book (IMAGE 2) lies on the coffee table next to the laptop, about 14% of the banner width.
TEXT ON THE BANNER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Headline overlaid on the photo with a soft dark gradient behind it, white, two lines: line 1 "Внуците ти показват телефона." line 2 "А кой ще ти покаже Excel?" - make "Excel" yellow #F5C518.
2) CTA button: "ВИЖ КАК →"
IMAGE 2 is the real book cover of the book "MS Excel Експерт". Reproduce it exactly on the physical book (printed paperback, slightly three-dimensional, natural shadow): same design, colours and all cover lettering letter by letter. Do not invent or change any cover text.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation and quotation marks. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Use a heavy, clean, condensed sans-serif for headlines (like Oswald Bold / Bebas-style weight but with full Cyrillic), unless the format below says otherwise.
- Text must be large and clearly legible on a phone at 380px width: headline lines at least ~6% of the banner height, subheadline ~3.5%, CTA text ~3.5%. Keep generous side margins (about 6% of the width).
- Strong contrast only: white or near-black text; accent words in warm yellow #F5C518; no grey text on dark backgrounds.
- CTA = rounded pill button in vivid red #E8232A with bold white uppercase text and an arrow →, centred near the bottom of the central area.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices of the book, percentages or website addresses anywhere.

PHOTO STYLE: realistic, natural-looking photo like a real Bulgarian everyday scene taken with a good phone camera; natural light, real skin texture; not glossy stock, no beauty filter. People have only two hands with five fingers each.

BOOK REALISM (critical - the book must NOT look pasted in like a sticker or a product render): the book is a real, physically present paperback that belongs to the scene. It lies casually at an angle (not facing the camera straight, not standing upright like a display), with correct perspective of the table/seat, lit by the SAME light as the scene (same colour temperature, same direction of light, soft natural shadow under and next to it, a little light falloff and reflection on the glossy cover), with the same depth of field as the objects around it (slightly soft if it is not in the focus plane), realistic size relative to the cup, phone and hands (a normal 13x20 cm paperback), slightly worn edges, and partly overlapped by something in the scene (a pen lying on it, a coffee cup or a hand at its edge, or a sheet of paper under it). The cover design must still be recognisable (title readable), but it should look like a photo taken of a real book in a real room, not added later.

CRITICAL POSITION CHECK: the FIRST line of any text must start no higher than 17% of the frame height from the top. The CTA button must end no lower than 87% of the frame height.
NO extra text anywhere in the scene: no posters, signs, wall lettering or written papers besides the book cover.
